findings: No new independent finding promoted from this test batch. Tests cover normal/negative gross profit, no sales, partial/all unknown food cost, posted wage distinction, expense ratios and no-wage wage-ratio null behavior.

Bounded completeness caveat: with wagePostingCount=0, ComputeOperatingMargin keeps a numeric OperatingResult subtracting zero wages and leaves IsComplete tied only to food cost coverage. The dashboard DTO exposes the result but its explicit completeness flag is IsFoodCostComplete; UI labels the wage row as posted wages and separately renders WagePercent as unknown. This is a potentially optimistic partial measure, but source comments/tests document that operating result means costs recorded by system, not net profit; missing rent/depreciation/unentered expense caveat is prominent. Existing financial ledger already records the same wage/packaging completeness limitation (ledger entry for this test path notes bounded estimate policy). No duplicate candidate raised.
OwnerDashboardVerticalSliceTests only verifies OperatingResult null when no sold line has any known food cost; it does not verify dashboard display for a period with no wage entries.

source_references.claim: OperatingResult is withheld when all sold food cost is unknown; otherwise numeric subtraction includes wages amount, while IsComplete only tracks food-cost line coverage and WagePercent is null when no wage posts.
Wage query counts posted earning ledger entries; builder passes the count to domain rules and projects nullable wage percent and operating result.
DTO explicitly calls completeness IsFoodCostComplete and comments WagePercent is null when no wage entry was posted; OperatingResult is a separate nullable number.
Dashboard displays posted wages and an unknown wage percent alongside operating result; caption says rents/depreciation/unregistered expense are excluded.
Domain tests assert absent wage postings produce null WagePercent but still a numeric OperatingResult; unknown food cost with no known line makes operating result null.
Integration test checks only that fully unknown food cost nulls operating result.
